stats.title: Usage %
stats.desc: Share of team possessions a player finishes himself (shot, free throws or turnover) while on court. The higher, the more the offense runs through him.

stats.title: True shooting %
stats.desc: Shooting efficiency that credits threes and free throws: PTS ÷ (2 × (FGA + 0.44 × FTA)). Better than plain FG%.

stats.title: Individual offensive rating
stats.desc: Points a player produces per 100 possessions he uses (own scoring, assists, offensive rebounds).

stats.title: Assist %
stats.desc: Share of the player's plays that end with an assist rather than a shot or turnover.

stats.title: Turnover %
stats.desc: Share of the player's plays that end in a turnover. Lower is better.

stats.title: 3PA rate
stats.desc: Share of the player's field-goal attempts taken from three.

stats.title: Created points
stats.desc: Points scored himself plus points teammates scored from his assists.

stats.title: Fouls drawn
stats.desc: Fouls drawn per game. They add to PIR.

stats.title: Individual defensive rating
stats.desc: Points allowed per 100 opponent possessions, based on the player's defensive contribution. Lower is better.

stats.title: Defensive rebound %
stats.desc: Share of available defensive rebounds (after opponent misses) he grabs while on court.

stats.title: Steal %
stats.desc: Share of opponent possessions, while he is on court, that end with his steal.

stats.title: Block %
stats.desc: Share of opponent shot attempts he blocks while on court.

stats.title: Stops
stats.desc: Opponent possessions per game he ends on defense (steal, block, defensive rebound, forced miss).

stats.title: Stop %
stats.desc: Share of opponent possessions he stops while on court.

stats.title: Individual net rating
stats.desc: Individual offensive minus defensive rating: points per 100 possessions the player adds.

stats.title: Team ORtg with him on court
stats.desc: Team points scored per 100 possessions while he is on court.

stats.title: Team DRtg with him on court
stats.desc: Opponent points per 100 possessions while he is on court. Lower is better.

stats.title: Possessions per game
stats.desc: Possessions played per game while he is on court. Reflects minutes and pace.

stats.title: Performance index rating
stats.desc: PTS + REB + AST + STL + BLK + fouls drawn − missed shots − turnovers − blocks against − fouls.
